# Feature matrix: original product operation vs. simulator experiments

"Original" means the function is documented for MSZ-AP35VGK / MUZ-AP35VG in the cited manual. Everything in the experiment layer is labelled as such in the app and never presented as a product function.

| Function | On the original unit | Source | In this app |
|---|---|---|---|
| STOP/OPERATE, OPERATION SELECT (AUTO/COOL/DRY/HEAT/FAN) | Yes | S2 p.21-23 | Remote. AUTO uses the documented 15 min / 1 °C changeover; DRY target from initial room temperature (rule assumed). |
| Set temperature 16-31 °C (COOL/DRY), 10-31 °C (HEAT) | Yes | S2 p.22-23, p.27 | Validated per mode; 0.5 °C steps (step size assumed). |
| FAN SPEED: AUTO, Silent, Low, Med, High, Super High | Yes (5 steps + AUTO) | S2 p.6 | Published rpm and airflow per step; AUTO logic is a surrogate. |
| VANE (up/down): AUTO, 1-5, SWING | Yes | S2 p.24 | Positions sourced, angles assumed; dew prevention, cold-air upward vane, upper-only swing in COOL/DRY/FAN. |
| WIDE VANE (left/right): 1-5, SWING | Yes | S2 p.25 | Stepping-motor vertical vanes; angles assumed. |
| ECONO COOL (+2 °C, vane swing) | Yes | S2 p.24 | +2 °C internal setpoint and swing; swing pattern assumed. |
| NIGHT MODE (outdoor noise limit) | Yes | S2 p.27 | Compressor and outdoor-fan caps (values assumed); indoor fan unchanged. |
| i-save (2 presets) | Yes | S2 p.28 | COOL/ECONO COOL and HEAT presets; not in DRY/AUTO. |
| ON/OFF timer, weekly timer (4/day, 28/week) | Yes | S2 p.25-27 | Simulated clock; weekly timer validated to 4/day and 28/week. |
| Operation lock | Yes | S2 p.28 | Locks mode changes only. |
| 3-minute restart delay | Yes | S2 p.28 | Enforced with visible countdown. |
| POWERFUL | No (AP60/71 only) | S2 p.24 | Not offered as original; "Turbo" exists only as an experiment. |
| LONG mode | No (AP60/71 only) | S2 p.25 | Not offered. |
| Eco power cap | No | - | Experiment layer: declared input cap; no fixed saving claimed. |
| Sleep schedule (setpoint drift) | No | - | Experiment layer, editable rate and limit. |
| Turbo (15 min higher demand) | No | - | Experiment layer; stays inside the frequency envelope and protections. |
| Manual compressor Hz, fan rpm, LEV %, vane angles | No | - | Engineering override; clipped by envelope and protections; limiting reason shown. |
| Outlet / mounting geometry edits | No | - | Design Lab experiment profiles with baseline overlay; vane count is visual-only. |
| Wi-Fi / MELCloud control | Yes (VGK) | S2 p.20 | Shown as a part only; no network or hardware control in this simulator. |
